scoring_notes: Backtest at 2024-09-01. All pentagon_jbook + doe_budget calls included cutoff_date='2024-09-01'. The J-Book divergence pattern does NOT trigger for RDW because the FY2023 10-K and Q2-2024 10-Q narrative does not name specific Pentagon Program Elements, PE numbers, or named DoD line-items (no SDA Tranche, AFRL Quantum, DARPA Blackjack, VICTUS, Skyborg, CCA, Project Maven, hypersonics, etc.). Defense-tinted claims are limited to: Link-16 antennas, an unnamed 'first generation national-security satellite constellation in LEO', Space Force GPS heritage, and a Space Test Program reference (the latter two are J-Book-FUNDED). usaspending confirms real DoD revenue at ~$85M across 26 awards under LoadPath / Redwire Space Solutions / Redwire Space Missions UEIs (AFRL Kirtland FA9453, AFRL Wright-Patterson FA8650, SMC FA8808) — the past defense revenue is REAL, not inflated. The non-disclosure of named PEs is itself a pattern but not within Mode A J-Book divergence — these are mostly DoD SBIR/STTR + AFRL component contracts, not Program-of-Record exposure. Mode B (implied verification): rollup-coherence with 9 acquisitions in 30 months returned INCOHERENT_ROLLUP, but with low information density (acq_coherence couldn't resolve target business details so all 8 scored 0.0 — flag this as low-confidence signal). Insider sales: 17 sales over 365 days, none proximate to budget-vote dates — NO_PROXIMATE_SALES (clean). Material weakness in ICFR unremediated through Q2-2024 is a non-J-Book negative.

scores.M_value: SDA Transport Layer Tranches 0-2 (PE 1206410SF): status_declared FUNDED_SHRINKING but signal NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE at 2024-09-01 cutoff (corpus history rows only cover FY26+). Link-16 / SDA queries: NOT_FOUND. contractor=Redwire: NOT_FOUND (J-Book corpus does not index Redwire). usaspending: 26 DoD awards = $85.2M (LoadPath, Redwire Space Solutions, Redwire Space Missions); contract descriptions include 'AFRL satellite component models', 'deployable structural booms for smallsat antennas', 'ATHENA articulated tensioned hexapod extendable nanosatellite antenna' — these are RF/structures component awards, not Tranche 1/2 prime contracts.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 7 applies: NOT_FOUND in corpus is not a red flag — Redwire is a sub-tier component supplier whose Link-16 antenna may be deployed on an SDA/national-security constellation but the company is not the J-Book line-item owner. The Transport Layer Tranches 0-2 primaries are York, Lockheed, Northrop (per corpus). Redwire's role would be sub-tier, so even FUNDED_SHRINKING on T0-T2 is only weakly transmissible to Redwire P&L. Score UNVERIFIABLE — claim is too vague to map to a specific PE.
